updates.summary: Initial source-backed baseline after PR #139; archived REA evidence and read-only bapX reference. Partial/missing count zero. General commerce parity excluded.

Reproduced static draft endpoint with zero provider calls, replaced it with actual completed model responses and reviewed proposals. Loopback route tests cover compatible and Google finish states, auth/CSRF, outage, links/images, Enterprise fields; Chrome synthetic UI at 1440/375/390 verifies apply/discard and stale edit protection. Live owner acceptance remains separate.

Inspected original WordPress Site Health source against archived REA digest; recorded concrete native contract. Implemented bounded deployed-source fingerprint and optional Git metadata, local CLI verification, red/green and actual HTTP fixtures. cms-13 stays partial because scheduler and complete system health are not implemented. Production evidence remains separate.

Read exact reference provider diagnostic source and preserved hashes. Replaced false HTTP/nonempty success with pinned text and synthetic native tool challenges; shared provider transport, no business access or routing mutations. Red/green loopback CLI and owner POST fixtures, isolated Chrome desktop/mobile passed. External model and live authenticated acceptance remain separate; no provider capability or cooldown claims.

Pinned both official skill collections and added one native reconstruction guide per original, 22 adaptations total. Preserved GPL notices and inert exact reference bytes; supplementary REA graph covers nine previously missing archive members. Catalog validation, native skill routing and private developer-only access. No product capability promoted or scope changed; implementation progress remains independent of research.

Selected native REA audit/design/implementation/verification skills and verified pinned ability source hashes. Migrated first existing read capability to typed native catalogue with strict bounded output and explicit missing-settings failure; no new external tool exposure. Both rows remain partial pending broader migration and external execution acceptance. Added continuous verified delivery and next-step reporting policy.

Continued next clear issue loop using native REA audit and shared-domain skills. Migrated published practitioner/programme lists and exact detail to typed catalogue with strict input/output, source checks, publication and module recheck. Representative MariaDB and loopback tests; external transport and remaining legacy tools still partial.

Developer-only map/index relocation, canonical generator and CLI output/validation paths, native REA skill discovery, retired duplicate task/objective commands and public path denial. No business-agent tools, runtime data, tracked capability scope or implementation status changed.

Migrated both public lexical retrieval abilities using pinned REA domain/validation contracts. Stable typed output and Unicode ranking, strict blog filtering, absent/unreadable data fails closed and no directory creation on read. Red/green fixture and isolated DB test coverage; six of 18 migrated, wider catalogue/knowledge and external transport remain partial.

Continued source-derived ability migration with five owner-only reads and domain projections. Stable aggregate outputs and explicit rolling period, no private ticket identity or content; INR minor-unit stored order totals not captured revenue. Scope/module validation, optional input and seeded MariaDB tests. Eleven of 18 migrated, wider catalogue and external acceptance still partial.

Migrated six existing commerce reads with strict owner/module gates and bounded schemas. Exact stored INR totals and actual coupon diagnostic inputs, no invented cart or new commerce scope. Seventeen of 18 migrated; external execution and session context remain incomplete.

Completed the 18-name internal typed native catalogue, replacing the final legacy dispatch with a trusted support-only session loader and explicit owned/public projections. Scoped discovery and invocation, bounded schemas and isolated cross-account/module verification. External execution acceptance remains partial.

Add published-read-only external MCP transport and independently revocable expiring bearer grants. Modern pinned protocol subset; no legacy/OAuth/live-client acceptance claim. Existing registry owns tool schemas and execution.

updates.scope_change: Owner separates bapXcms service-first CMS/CRM from the commerce-led bapXphpAiBackend; retail runtime retirement replaces preserve-existing-shop direction. Existing 61 scoped acceptance units remain unchanged; configurable ERP extensions need separately scoped contracts.
